Recorded claim:
In D208830 the reviewer asked for view-flag tests; the author checked existing coverage and added four named tests to test_viewWrapper_virtualFolder.js. They spread reply threads across two folders and check unthreaded, threaded, grouped-by-sort, and persisted transitions after close/reopen. The tests check flag bits and row levels or dummy/container rows. Their own comment limits the first three to view-wrapper sanity checks, so they do not prove every backend ordering case. In this test file, name each add_task test_virtual_folder_threading_<case> and test the cross-folder data shape that exposed the bug.

Provenance: 806ac1039f36b949f02b379476378588da37f9b5f0b62507cb8135e0ab8561f1. Original evidence IDs: 2cbf979607deba7e0de3c3046b2634d6ff43e2c1f185d1345d97a656d03067b1, 5f356b08f8be2e23ee7e905c1b64476cbf8da556c68db2b035e8cdd74d68c657, b7753189f939721b751fa64a2ace7b1064695bd22bea3c8e61236aecb4e2a50d.
